title: Remaining gaps in LEET
headline: One NEW defect (keys 3 and 7 are 100% harmful / 0% useful, contradicting the brief's blanket 'every key is load-bearing'); otherwise a clean bill of health - the ratio-anomaly test applied to all 284 mixed types (not just France's 24) isolates exactly the three already-known classes and nothing else.

denominator.source: name_tokens, all 6 profile files, tokens matching both [a-z] and [0-9]

new_defect_N4.claim: LEET keys '3' and '7' have a 100% damage rate in the measured window and zero correct expansions.
new_defect_N4.contradicts: FLEET_BRIEF 'Every LEET key is LOAD-BEARING' - established only for keys 1 and 4
new_defect_N4.confidence: CONFIRMED for the measured top-4000 window; tail unmeasured
new_defect_N4.caveat: 8-18% of name-token mass is outside the top-4000 cut, so this is a floor not a census

ratio_test_all_284.criterion: ratio = n(country,mixed) / n(country,LEET_output), both summed over 6 name_tokens lists
ratio_test_all_284.new_coverage: D090 ran this only on France's 24 types; D121 ran it on all 284

anomalous_types.verdict: adjudicated NOT a defect by D087 4e
control - digit 2 is not a LEET key

ratio_test_all_284.conclusion: The anomaly set is exactly the known defect set. No fourth corruption class found in the measured window.

units.verdict: 24hr already known; family of exactly one member

versions.verdict: street slots, address side where LEET never fires

resolutions_4K_1080p.verdict: not in the top 4000, any country, either column

grades.verdict: all genuine leet; India a1 16283, b1 13325, a2 11135, b2 9346, a4 4294 are address-side

two_or_more_digits.verdict: 24hr is the ONLY multi-digit mixed name token in the dataset

address_side_ordinal_family_NEW.correction_note: An earlier draft of this file said 53 types / 1,732,021 occ using an enumerated 1st-30th list. The full regex gives 184 types / 1,986,432 occ; the enumerated list had missed high US ordinals. The corrected figures are the ones reported in the .md.
address_side_ordinal_family_NEW.conclusion: Address side preserves 1,986,432 ordinal occurrences; name side destroys 1,060. LEET never fires on addresses (normalize.py:342-349 uses canon.get(t,t) with no translate).

cross_country.note: France - the scored country - is the SMALLEST contributor. Country is not in scope on this path: normalize_name(raw) takes no country (normalize.py:285) and prep.py:12 supplies none. A country guard is not implementable without changing a public signature.

collisions.only_genuine_cross_country_convergence: 1st -> lst (US 679 + India 381) - desirable, one fix covers both

dead_weight.proof: _non_alnum = re.compile(r'[^a-z0-9]+') at normalize.py:269 splits at line 276 before translate at line 280, so tokens are guaranteed [a-z0-9] only
dead_weight.note: Keys 3 and 7 are not dead - they fire, but only to cause harm (see new_defect_N4)

gaps_not_filled: No raw TSV read, so 4l (ratio 3.012) is not independently re-litigated; D087's verdict stands and it remains the least-evidenced item
Profile has no field giving row counts containing a given token
Untruncated tail mass is not computable from the profile
build_profile.py TOKEN_RE [a-z0-9]+ does no accent stripping, so 1ere appears as 1 + re; accented counts are split across 2+ entries and are floors

mechanism_traced.corrupt_token_path: normalize.py:280 corrupts -> normalize.py:306 into core -> keys.py:33-34 nt (filter len>=2 only, so eeme/lst/2ahr/teme become live blocking keys) -> features.py:128-129 wn via name_idf
mechanism_traced.address_path: keys.py:39-43 alph from raw atoks; keys.py:60 kind-0 key = th ^ (ah//2) XOR of name and address hashes - cannot form when lst != 1st
mechanism_traced.separate_idf_tables: features.py:128 (name_idf) vs 129 (addr_idf) - address side can never rescue the name side
mechanism_traced.not_cleaned_downstream: eeme/ler/teme/lere are in neither NAME_CANON nor NAME_STOP (normalize.py:306 drops only NAME_STOP)

verdict.clean_bill_of_health_for: all other shape families; the three known classes are exhaustive in the measured window
verdict.fix_still_belongs_at: the call site (_name_tokens, normalize.py:279-280), not the table - D087 section 6 stands
verdict.guard_must_be: token-anchored (^...$) and exempting rather than extending; country-blind because France contributes only 19.1%
